name: How much can luxury custom home finishes change the timeline?

mainEntity.name: Do high-end finishes and custom millwork slow down a custom home build significantly?
mainEntity.text: Do high-end finishes and custom millwork slow down a custom home build significantly?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-end finishes can absolutely affect the schedule, especially when the project relies on custom fabrication, imported materials, or specialty trades. Custom millwork, stone slabs, specialty lighting, oversized doors, and unique hardware all need more lead time and tighter coordination than standard finishes. Some items also require field verification, shop drawings, or mockups before installation can begin. If selections are made late, the builder may have to resequence work or temporarily leave areas incomplete until the products arrive. That can create downtime and raise costs. The most efficient luxury projects lock in finish selections early, coordinate them with the design team, and confirm long-lead items before construction reaches the installation phase. This is one of the biggest differences between a smooth luxury build and one that feels constantly delayed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, luxury finishes can slow the project because they often require longer lead times, more coordination, and additional inspections or mockups. Custom millwork, specialty stone, imported fixtures, and built-in cabinetry may affect ordering and installation sequencing. The earlier these selections are locked in, the smoother the schedule.
